_comment: Hand-checked tagging cases, frozen from the 42-record review on
2026-09-04 that justified shipping this. The review was done by eye,
once -- these turn a sample of it into something that runs on every
publish, so the tagger cannot regress quietly.
Two Azure cases judged imprecise in that review are deliberately
absent: freezing them would lock in behaviour already called wrong.
Regenerate only after re-checking by hand; a green run against a
